## Inline comment — `clap_builder/src/parser/parser.rs:135-138` (RIGHT)

**[P1] [must-fix] Escape-token guard swallows `--` into an unrelated argument or hard-errors it**

**Triggers when:** The positional at the current `pos_counter` has `value_terminator("--")`, and either (a) a different option with open-ended `num_args` (no `allow_hyphen_values`, no terminator of its own) is still collecting values when `--` arrives, or (b) that positional is `.last(true)` and `--` is the very first token.

**Impact:** In case (a), `--` (and everything after it) is silently pushed as a plain value of the unrelated option instead of ending its collection, so the intended positional gets nothing and no error is raised. In case (b), `--` is instead rejected with `unknown_argument`, even though the merge-base parsed it successfully — a previously working invocation now hard-fails.

**Change:** At `clap_builder/src/parser/parser.rs:135-138`, take this branch only when no other argument is actively mid-collection (`!matches!(parse_state, ParseState::Opt(_))`), and have it directly finish the `pos_counter` positional's collection there — mirroring the existing terminator handling at parser.rs:414-417 (resolve pending, increment `pos_counter`, set `ParseState::ValuesDone`) — instead of leaving `--` to whichever later block happens to receive it.

**Source:** Pull request body: "Adjust escape handling so the current positional's value_terminator takes precedence over entering trailing-values mode when it matches --."

items.markdown:
**[P2] [must-fix] Guard the escape/value-terminator check against an active option state**

**Triggers when:** An option without `allow_hyphen_values` (e.g. `.long("out").num_args(1)`) is still awaiting its value when the literal `--` token arrives, and some not-yet-reached positional at the current position counter has `value_terminator("--")`.

**Impact:** The new branch at `clap_builder/src/parser/parser.rs:135-137` checks that *positional*'s terminator instead of the option actually being collected, then falls through into the unchanged `ParseState::Opt` handling (around line 290), which finds no terminator on the option and pushes `--` as its literal value. `prog --out -- foo` now silently succeeds with `out == ["--"]`, `pos == ["foo"]`; at the merge-base this same input errored, because `--` always ended the option's value collection instead of being pushed into it.

**Change:** Exclude `ParseState::Opt(_)` from the new branch's condition (e.g. `!matches!(parse_state, ParseState::Opt(_)) && self.cmd.get_keymap()...`), so this token still falls to the pre-existing `trailing_values = true; continue;` path whenever an active option — not the pending positional — is what is actually consuming it.

**[P1] [must-fix] Restore `--`'s escape effect for every token after a consumed value-terminator**

**Triggers when:** A positional's own `value_terminator` is the literal `--`, so the new branch at `clap_builder/src/parser/parser.rs:135-137` consumes it without ever setting `trailing_values`; every token that follows is then processed as if the user had never typed `--` at all.

**Impact:** (a) A `.last(true)` positional following a value-terminated one becomes unreachable via a single `--`: `prog -- x` now hard-errors with `unknown_argument` where it used to assign `x` to `.last` via the pre-existing `trailing_values && contains_last` jump (`parser.rs:379-385`, guard at `parser.rs:392`) — a shape `clap_builder/src/builder/debug_asserts.rs:567-569` explicitly permits. (b) A subcommand typed after `--` gets dispatched instead of taken literally, because the subcommand guard at `parser.rs:112-128` no longer sees `trailing_values` set — breaking `--`'s basic "nothing after this is re-interpreted" guarantee. (c) A later hyphen-leading value (e.g. `-l`) is parsed as an unknown option instead of a positional value.

**Change:** In the success arm of `check_terminator` inside the positional-consumption block (`parser.rs:413-417`), also set `trailing_values = true`, gated on `arg_os.is_escape()` so non-`--` terminators (e.g. `;`) are unaffected. Do not set it inside the branch at `135-137` itself: that runs before the `pos_counter` correction block (`parser.rs:319-389`) for the *same* token, and would misroute it through the `.last` jump instead of terminating the intended positional, reintroducing a variant of (a).
